newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Skilled nine-month net profit tumbles.
newsitem.headline: Skilled nine-month net profit tumbles.

text.p: Contract labour firm Skilled Engineering Ltd said on Thursday that net profit fell 45.1 percent to A$4.99 million in the nine months ended March 31 while sales rose 21.4 percent to A$255.37 million.

"The company's earnings performance has ...been disappointing and was below our expectations. The poor result was due primarily to a loss incurred by the Communications Division during the quarter," Skilled said.
The Communications unit was affected by pay television operator Optus Vision's decision to review its cable rollout.
"The main contributor to this loss was the scale-back of several contracts with Optus," Skilled said.
"The abrupt nature of the scale back forced the company to dispose of surplus equipment and vehicles and to make significant retrenchment payments," it said.
